title: Japan defense chief plans talks with S. Korea counterpart in Cebu

blocks.text: Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi said Tuesday he plans to meet with his South Korean counterpart on the sidelines of a gathering of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and partner countries later this week in Cebu in the Philippines. In addition to meeting for the first time with South Korean Defense Minister Kang Shin Chul, who took office in September, Koizumi also hopes to hold talks with his U.S. and Philippine counterparts, Pete Hegseth and Gilberto Teodoro, respectively, during the three-day trip to Cebu from Wednesday.
